Biology 2017-II.question: Which one of the following proteins gives lustrous shiny appearance to silk fibre?
Biology 2017-II.explanation: (a)  Silk is a fibre produced by the silkworm in production of its cocoon. It consists mainly of two proteins, fibroin and sericin. Silk consists of 70–80% fibroin and 20–30% sericin; fibroin being the structural center of the silk, and sericin being the gum coating the fibres and allowing them to stick to each other.
